name: truncate
title: Truncate
description: A value that does not fit, cut with an ellipsis, with the whole of it in a tooltip. The tooltip appears only when the text is ACTUALLY clipped, so a column of short values has no hover behaviour at all. A table gets one of three answers to a long value: wrap it (and lose the scan), widen the row (and lose the page), or this. Never use it on a column header: a header nobody can read is a column nob
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Truncate.json
